leverage_field_audit.finding: Closed trade records do NOT contain a leverage field. The system operates in paper mode with implied leverage from notional sizing. Actual leverage = notional / account_margin is unknown from closed trade records alone.
leverage_field_audit.implied_leverage_estimate: With $10,000 initial capital and median notional $72 per position, and ~83 concurrent open positions (per portfolio state), total open notional ≈ $67,512 → implied leverage ≈ 6.75x at peak

drawdown_tracking.finding: drawdown_at_entry=0.0 for all 645 trades. The adaptive capital reduction via drawdown_block_bps and drawdown_reduce_bps in strategy router is dead code — never triggers.

size_multiplier_evidence.interpretation: 32/645 trades entered reduce_size_mode — meaning 32 trades had size_multiplier < 0.999. This confirms adaptive sizing triggers exist but fire rarely.
reduce_size_triggers: DRAWDOWN_REDUCE_SIZE (0.5x) — never fires due to zero drawdown

margin_mode.finding: No margin_mode field in closed trade records. Paper mode does not track margin mode.
margin_mode.live_gate_requirement: Any live trading must specify ISOLATED or CROSS margin per symbol before approval

confidence: MEDIUM — notional computed from entry_price × closed_quantity; leverage not stored
